objective: Deliver HYDRAGROW User Discovery & Strategic Research Report clarifying user personas, JTBD, IA alignment, and unresolved governance questions without modifying implementation code.

acceptance.criterion: Design brief outlines the problem space, code/schema-supported user groups, and assumption-based user groups with source citations.
Database query methodology provides SQL for user/device topology, multi-station distribution, and season cadence with explicit finding on Open Question 1.
Two to three distinct JTBD hypotheses are defined across functional, emotional, and social dimensions without pre-selecting defaults.
Personas corresponding to top JTBD tracks are explicitly labeled as HYPOTHESIS — unverified.
End-to-end crop cycle journey is mapped and cross-referenced against the current 5-tab IA identifying cognitive and sequence mismatches.
A structured, non-leading interview script targeting 5 user archetypes directly probes the 3 open questions.
Quantitative sensor metrics methodology is defined with uncalibrated constants labeled as assumptions and an actionable post-access calibration procedure provided.
Authoritative Decisions & Status Table is completed with immediate actionability indicated for security bugs, and CURRENT-STATUS.md is updated.
